attributes.title: Full assessment: due 30 calendar days after the initiation date. "Due soon" means within 2 calendar days of the due date; the daily reminder flow uses working days and bank holidays.

style.color: =if(length([$InitiationDate]) == 0, '#3B3A39', if(length([$AssessmentSent]) > 0 && [$AssessmentSent] < addDays([$InitiationDate], 31), '#0B5A0B', if(length([$AssessmentSent]) > 0, '#7A3105', if([$Stage] == 'Concluded', '#3B3A39', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 31), '#8E1F25', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 28), '#5C4300', '#004578'))))))
style.background-color: =if(length([$InitiationDate]) == 0, '#F3F2F1', if(length([$AssessmentSent]) > 0 && [$AssessmentSent] < addDays([$InitiationDate], 31), '#DFF6DD', if(length([$AssessmentSent]) > 0, '#FDE7D9', if([$Stage] == 'Concluded', '#F3F2F1', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 31), '#FDE7E9', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 28), '#FFF4CE', '#EFF6FC'))))))

=if(length([$InitiationDate]) == 0, '#605E5C', if(length([$AssessmentSent]) > 0 && [$AssessmentSent] < addDays([$InitiationDate], 31), '#107C10', if(length([$AssessmentSent]) > 0, '#B84500', if([$Stage] == 'Concluded', '#605E5C', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 31), '#A4262C', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 28), '#8A6400', '#0067B8'))))))

children.txtContent: =if(length([$InitiationDate]) == 0, 'No start date', if(length([$AssessmentSent]) > 0 && [$AssessmentSent] < addDays([$InitiationDate], 31), 'Sent', if(length([$AssessmentSent]) > 0, 'Sent late', if([$Stage] == 'Concluded', 'Not needed', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 31), 'Overdue', if(@now >= addDays([$InitiationDate], 28), 'Due soon', 'On track'))))))
